Change 1636 pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1636

Local gates before push: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (503 files), unit suite 7417 passed / 14 skipped. The one unit error was a harness artifact, not a defect: tests/unit/test_push_retry_stash_pop.py guards against a test moving the repo HEAD, and I committed while the suite was running, so it saw HEAD move 06335f71b1 -> 1d7fc26859. Re-ran that file against a stable HEAD: 3 passed.

Follow-up filed for the deliberately out-of-scope gates: beryl-orange-oropendola (fba8-5271-add6-4603), linked discovered_from this ticket. review-code is mostly wiring (it already has a coverage object); verify-completion has no coverage object at all, so it needs a placement decision first. The recording site needs no change either way, since every LLM call already funnels through the one runner seam.
